name: apptochain
description: apptochain monorepo — contracts, SDK, relayer, demo and builder dashboard

scripts.build: npm run abis -w @apptochain/contracts && npm run build -w @apptochain/sdk && npm run build -w @apptochain/react && npm run build -w @apptochain/demo && npm run build -w @apptochain/dashboard
scripts.test: npm test -w @apptochain/contracts && node packages/relayer/test/store.test.mjs && node scripts/e2e.mjs
